klaim.bukti: In this review, we mainly focus on the research on pedestrian tracking. [...] according to all data collected for this review, at least 70% of current MOT research efforts are devoted to pedestrians.
klaim.catatan: Tinjauan pelacakan multiobjek yang berfokus pada pejalan kaki; teks tidak memuat kata agriculture atau fruit, sehingga pernyataan bahwa tinjauan ini berada di luar pertanian sesuai.

yang_dicoba: Semantic Scholar API (abstrak disembunyikan penerbit; hanya TLDR tersedia)

klaim.bukti: [parafrasa web] TLDR Semantic Scholar: the best model is EfficientNetB0, trained with transfer learning, 9 angle crop, and float16 quantization, achieving an overall test accuracy of 0.893 on TensorFlow Lite; second-best MobileNetV1 with 0.811.
klaim.catatan: Judul dan TLDR menyatakan klasifikasi kematangan TBS dengan jaringan konvolusi (EfficientNetB0, MobileNetV1) pada TensorFlow Lite untuk perangkat seluler. Teks lengkap tidak terakses.

klaim.bukti: Our experimentation is conducted over four growing seasons in several wine and table-grape vineyards. [...] yield estimates that capture up to 75% of spatial yield variance and with an average error between 3% and 11% of total yield.
klaim.catatan: Empat musim tanam dan 75% varians spasial hasil panen sesuai dengan abstrak.

klaim.halaman: Seksi 5.1, h. 11; Seksi 5.4, h. 19; Tabel 2, h. 20
klaim.bukti: Our counting accuracy from both sides for Dataset1, Dataset3 and Dataset4 are 94.81%, 91.98%, and 94.68% respectively.
klaim.perbaikan: then merged counts from both sides of the row on three validation datasets of 22 trees in total (6, 10, and 6 trees; 958 harvested apples), with an accuracy of 91.98–94.81% against harvested counts [roy2019vision]. (The 252 trees are the three rows of the overall field trials, not the two-sided merging test.)
klaim.catatan: Rentang 91,98–94,81% benar. Angka 252 pohon adalah total tiga baris uji lapangan (abstrak, h. 1); penggabungan dua sisi hanya diuji pada Dataset1, Dataset3, dan Dataset4 (6 + 10 + 6 = 22 pohon; 270 + 274 + 414 apel). Nilai 252 pada Tabel 2 adalah jumlah buah hasil gabungan Dataset3, bukan jumlah pohon.

klaim.bukti: A key issue in detecting Fresh Fruit Bunches (FFB) in UAV imagery is occlusion, caused by overlapping fronds, clustered bunches, and inconsistent viewing angles, which often leads to undetected or misclassified objects.
klaim.catatan: Abstrak menyebut oklusi oleh pelepah pada citra UAV, ditangani dengan Loss Rank Mining pada YOLOv11. Oklusi juga disebabkan tandan yang bergerombol dan sudut pandang, tetapi kalimat naskah tidak keliru.

klaim.bukti: A conventional way to solve the association between the predicted Kalman states and newly arrived measurements is to build an assignment problem that can be solved using the Hungarian algorithm.
klaim.catatan: Kalman filter kecepatan konstan dan penugasan Hungarian sesuai. Metrik asosiasi studi ini adalah jarak Mahalanobis digabung jarak kosinus penampilan (bukan hanya tumpang-tindih), yang tercakup oleh frasa 'usually ... overlap or distance'.
